title: Steroid
features:
Select Boss: menu to manually choose which boss you want to focus on from the list

Auto TP and Attack Closest Boss: finds the nearest boss teleports to its legs and attacks non stop until it dies

Fast Kill Selected Boss: focuses only on the chosen boss teleports right to it and unleashes super fast punches

Auto Farm Chest: automatically collects the game chest to get real server gold without moving there

Auto Teleport Obby: instantly completes the game obby to claim the real gold reward

Trigger Fake Gold Visual: runs a visual test on your screen to fake winning gold (client side only)

Fetch Server Gold: checks directly with the server to show your actual real gold inside the menu

Auto Stage: automatically buys all stages and upgrades directly through the server

Instant Sell and Return: teleports you to the sell area and brings you back to the exact same spot in a blink

Click Save Coordinate: saves the exact 3D position where your character is standing right now

TP Loop To Saved Coordinate: keeps teleporting you back to the saved spot every millisecond so you dont get pushed away

Stop Loop: stops the position lock and lets you walk freely around the map again

Select Language: changes the menu text between english and russian
